title: fix(app-shell): AI chat publish seed warning says the pack sentence, not engine text
body:

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_
Fixes #35303

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:在 AI 对话页发布草稿时,如果示例数据(seed)载入失败,警告提示的详情行改为语言包里的那句「示例数据未能加载。」,不再显示 seed 载入器的英文内部报错,也不再显示 `[object Object]`。
- 为什么改:用中文发布的搭建者会在警告下看到英文引擎文本,或在只有逐行错误时看到 `[object Object]`;#32984 的裁决是面向用户的文字只用客户句。首页「全部发布」已由 #35301 改好,这是同族的第二个入口。
- 风险与回滚:只改 `onPublishDrafts` 里警告详情取哪句话,另把引擎文本与错误行原样打到浏览器控制台(`console.warn`);不动接口、语言键和导出。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`(`onPublishDrafts` 里 `console.ai.seedWarn` 那一处 toast);`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.seedWarnPackSentence-35303.test.tsx`;`.changeset/35303-ai-chat-seed-warn-pack-sentence.md`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/__tests__/AiChatPage.seedWarnPackSentence-35303.test.tsx`,预期 6 个用例全绿(en 与 zh-Hans 两种语言)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

`AiChatPage`'s `onPublishDrafts` warns `console.ai.seedWarn` when the publish answers `seedApplied.success === false`. The warning's description used to be `seedApplied.error` (the seed loader's engine text), else `String(seedApplied.errors[0])`, which reads `[object Object]` for a structured `{ row, reason }` row.

The description is now always the pack sentence `chatbot.build.health.seedFailed`: the sentence the chat's publish-health line says for the same failure and the one *Publish all* says since #35301 (objectstack#32984 Q1 ruling: user-facing text is the customer sentence, never developer or engine text). The engine text and the error rows go to `console.warn('[app-shell] Published, but the seed failed to load:', { packageId, error, errors })`, whole, and they still reach the health line's technical details through `publishHealthFromResponse`, which this diff does not touch.

The changeset is `patch` on `@object-ui/app-shell`. No locale keys, props or exports change.

## Tests

New file `AiChatPage.seedWarnPackSentence-35303.test.tsx`, built on the `publishAdvisoryReachesAuthor` harness (the real handler, `useMetadataClient` and its client; stubbed `sonner`, `fetch` and the chat tree reduced to the button that fires `onPublishDrafts`), plus `I18nProvider` with the shipped `en` and `zh-Hans` packs. Its own file because `I18nProvider` installs a module-level i18next global, which would leak into the sibling pin's default-value reads.

- engine-text arm: a batch whose `seedApplied` failed with `error` shows the pack's `seedWarn` title and `seedFailed` description; the engine text is absent from the toast and present in the one `console.warn` line;
- structured-row arm: a batch whose `seedApplied` failed with `errors: [{ row, reason }]` and no `error` shows the pack sentence, never `[object Object]`; the row reaches `console.warn` as an object;
- CONTROL: a seed that loaded raises no warning, no seed console line, and one `publishOk` success toast.

Each case runs in `en` and `zh-Hans` (6 cases).

## Acceptance notes

- Family check: the other `seedApplied` readers under `ui/` are `usePublishAllDrafts` (fixed by #35301), `publishHealthFromResponse` (already folds the detail under technical details) and the client's type declaration; no third toast producer was found.
